consumer_rules: POST call_request to /v1/datasources/custom-mcp/call with the turn key as the Authorization Bearer, through the datasources Ingress; never in the body.
Send back the connection_id and credential_version the turn's custom_mcp block carries, and the tool's own name as the server listed it.
tool passes auth's usable name rule (custom-mcp-limits-v1.json, max_tool_name_length); arguments are a JSON object of at most 256 KiB as compact UTF-8.
content holds the server's text parts in order, then at most one structured part when the server sent an object nested at most 64 deep; dropped_content_types names every content type left out, once.
member_tools_request is POSTed in-cluster to /v1/datasources/custom-mcp/member-tools with the member's own credential as the Authorization Bearer; it is not served through the Ingress.
A 502 or 504 leaves the application as 503 with upstream_status set to it; read code, not the status, to tell failures apart.

errors.meaning: No bearer, the Ingress gate stamped no identity on a call, or auth refused the member's credential.
CUSTOM_MCP_GATEWAY__ENABLED is off, or the resolver identity is missing.
The body is not exactly this shape, tool is not a usable name, or arguments are over 256 KiB or not strict JSON; nothing was sent.
auth will not resolve this connection for this turn key, or the member has no signed-in server with this name.
auth or the call-rate store could not be asked, auth answered another binding, auth's switch is off, the token is being refreshed, or the member signed in again during the listing.
The server URL is on or under our own domains, an IP literal, an xn-- host or not on port 443, or its host resolves to an address that is not public.
The tool is not switched on for this connection; nothing was sent to the server.
The server refused its token after a fresh resolve, or auth could not refresh it; the member must sign in again.
The grant's calls for this 60 s window, auth's resolve or lookup rate, or the open calls allowed for this connection, this turn or this process are used up.
The call outlasted its 45 s deadline, or the listing its 30 s.
The server's answer is over 1 MiB, or echoes the token too often to scrub. Nothing of the answer is returned.
A listing page is over 1 MiB, the listing over 2 MiB, or the sync body over 3 MiB. Nothing is stored.

The server could not be reached, failed, or answered something that is not strict JSON-RPC; the answer could not be written as strict JSON; or the scrub could not run. Nothing of the answer leaves and nothing is stored.
